name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 8 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-02-19, at wavelengths from 1.48 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
